summary: Converts primitive geometry into triangle strips, a render-friendly representation that can be faster than individual triangles or quads.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Primitive group to convert; blank converts the full input

key_params.name: constrainstriplength
key_params.note: Limit generated strips to a maximum triangle count

key_params.name: maxstriplength
key_params.note: Maximum number of triangles per strip when constrained

common_gotchas: Tristrip SOP changes primitive organization; downstream tools expecting original primitive numbers may break.
Use a source group when only render-heavy portions of geometry need strip conversion.
Maximum strip length can trade render batching for more predictable topology chunks.
This is an optimization and formatting tool, not a substitute for geometry cleanup or normal repair.
key_concepts: Tristrip SOP converts primitive geometry into triangle strips.
Triangle strips can render faster than separate triangles or quads.
Source Group limits conversion to selected primitives while blank group converts all input geometry.
Strip length can be constrained to a maximum triangle count for predictable topology chunks.
